# Prashant Chataut

> Prashant Chataut builds apps from Nepal: NEBians (study platform), Retra (Android GBA emulator), and Prody (journaling without streaks).

## About

- [About](https://knowprashant.vercel.app/#about): Mobile and web apps. Design, code, ship.

## Projects

- [NEBians](https://nebians.consica.com.np/): Notes, past papers, forums for students and teachers. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neb.ians). Instagram: [@the_nebians](https://www.instagram.com/the_nebians).
- [Retra](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Retra): Android GBA emulator. In development.
- [Prody](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Prody): Journaling and reflection without streak guilt.
